facts.fact: The Citizen reports on 12 February 2026 that the PDPC enforces the Personal Data Protection Act, Chapter 44, and links to coverage of the law coming into effect.
PDPC Director General Dr Emanuel Mkilia spoke in Mbeya on 11 February 2026 at the opening of a DPO seminar and announced inspections.

The PDPC announced nationwide compliance inspections from 9 April 2026 of institutions that failed to register and appoint DPOs, and said it would take legal action on violations; training seminars were under way.
The PDPC announced on 11 February 2026 a shift from awareness-raising to enforcement, with inspections from 9 April.
